title: Vibrant Savory Spanish Shrimp Pisto Manchego
description: A savory and pillowy Spanish dish featuring shrimp, pisto manchego, and a mirepoix base, perfect for a crowd-pleasing dinner. This recipe combines the flavors of Spain with the convenience of a one-pot meal.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large hot pot vessel over medium-high heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until translucent, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional 1 minute.
Add the chopped red bell pepper and cook until tender, about 5 minutes.
Add the pisto manchego paste and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the diced tomato, smoked paprika, salt, and black pepper, and stir to combine.
Add the peeled and deveined shrimp and cook until pink and fully cooked, about 5 minutes.
Serve the vibrant savory Spanish shrimp pisto manchego hot, garnished with fresh parsley or cilantro if desired.
Offer crusty bread or rice on the side to soak up the flavorful sauce.
Enjoy the dish with a glass of red wine or a refreshing Spanish beer.
